Class InMemoryRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:

public class InMemoryRepository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>> extends Object implements Repository<ID,E>
In-memory implementation of Repository backed by a Map.
